identity.title: Show picked XYZ coordinates in the Viewer status bar

origin.summary: The owner requested Viewer coordinates, including the Z axis, in the bottom status area.

state.current_summary: The Viewer bottom status now persistently exposes the existing selected X/Y/Z and C3D raw height, including an explicit localized empty state, with current Release Wide/Compact, pointer, regression, and R0-input evidence passing.

objective.summary: Show the current picked X, Y, and Z coordinates in the Viewer bottom status bar without changing selection or inspection behavior.
constraints: Reuse PickCoordinate for C3D, mesh, LAZ, and generated geometry; do not add duplicate coordinate calculation or mouse-move scanning.
Keep camera and unit status visible and preserve explicit Viewer Y-up coordinate semantics.
Use existing Viewer graphite styling, localization, accessibility, and responsive Wide/Compact behavior.
The presentation change must not mutate recipe, source, ROI, result, Preview, Publish, Run, or Validation state.

criteria.text: The Viewer bottom status visibly labels and shows the selected point's X, Y, and Z values, including Z, with an explicit empty state.
The status reuses the existing PickCoordinate state for supported Viewer sources and adds no new coordinate or picking implementation.
Current Release Wide and Compact layouts remain themed, readable, bounded, accessible, and preserve camera/unit status without inspection side effects.
Focused Viewer regression, Release build, screenshot quality, monitor intersection, and refreshed R0 input validation pass with durable evidence.

context.summary: PickCoordinate already owns the exact selected-point presentation across Viewer source types.
The Viewer bottom bar currently presents only BottomStatus camera and unit text.

evidence.observation: Wide and Compact C3D picks visibly show labeled X/Y/Z plus raw height, and Compact first entry visibly shows the localized empty state; all screenshot-quality reports were accepted on attempt 1.
The status surface binds directly to MainWindowViewModel.PickCoordinate; no new coordinate calculation, pointer scanning, selection handler, service, or inspection action was introduced.

Current Release Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 captures retain full camera/unit and coordinate rows, intersect the selected leftmost monitor, and actual pointer pick/orbit/pan/zoom/Fit/context-menu regression passed.
Viewer runtime passed 103/103, docking/theme 87/87, Shell options 40/40, structure 29/29, full Release built with 0 warnings and 0 errors, and refreshed Wide/Compact R0 ValidateOnly passed.

events.summary: Resolved after selected and empty status states, reuse of existing picking, responsive actual-EXE layouts, regressions, Release, and R0 input validation passed.
